column5: Q2 2026 10-Q, filed 2026-07-23 (condensed consolidated balance sheet, thousands): every liability as printed, and none is a borrowing. The FY2025 10-K (0001599298-26-000015, Note 12, Promissory Note Payable to Related Parties) states 'As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company had no debt' after the last of the December 2022 notes from Mr. Duggan was 'repaid in full on October 1, 2024', and the half year's financing cash flows are equity alone: 'Proceeds from the issuance of common stock under at-the-market offering, net of commissions 227,413 ... Proceeds received related to employee stock purchase plan and exercise of stock options 7,462 ... Net cash provided by financing activities 234,875'. Leases are not counted here. After that date Summit sold the $68.4mm left on its first at-the-market agreement and $25.7mm of a new $380mm one with J.P. Morgan (8-K 0001193125-26-314214; $354.3mm unsold at 2026-10-01, PRE 14A 0001193125-26-415755), and AstraZeneca bought $2.0bn of Class A convertible preferred stock at $18,356.14 a share, each convertible into 1,000 common shares, 108,955,369 in all (8-K 0001193125-26-405776, agreement of 2026-09-28); 'The closing of the Private Placement occurred on October 5, 2026' (PRE 14A 0001193125-26-415755). The preferred takes dividends only as common does, on an as-converted basis, and shares pro rata with common on liquidation after $0.01 a share, so it is equity, not debt. It must be redeemed for cash at market value if the charter amendment that allows conversion is not effective by 2028-04-05 (same PRE 14A).
